system.flavor: Nova Arms' attempt to bring the revolver up to date: instead of a traditional cylinder it uses disposable 'Ammo Cassettes' of superstrong composite ceramic, preloaded with seven .338 Nova cartridges. Twin triple-porting on the octagonal barrel works as a muzzle compensator, which is what lifts the ROF to 3.
system.notes:
Chromebook 2 p.40 (PDF idx 137) text layer: P +1 J P 3D6 (.338) 7 3 VR 50M, 460EB. Confirmed verbatim by Blackhand's Street Weapons p.15 (PDF idx 16): 460eb, P +1 J P 3D6 (.338) 7 3 VR 50M.

Note on .338 Nova: a rimmed, brass-cased cartridge firing a 98-grain bullet at 1695 fps, placing it around the .357 Magnum - an ideal mid-range load. Ammo 15eb per box of 50; empty Ammo Cassettes 5eb each, pre-loaded shrink-wrapped cassettes 7eb each. Two spare cassettes ship with every gun.
